prompt: Deliverable: one painterly dark gothic anime light-novel visual-novel bust of a single character, portrait 2:3, made for a flat-colour cut-out: the "soft smile" expression variant of the approved bust in reference image 1. Reference image roles are listed below the prompt. IDENTITY AND CROP LOCK: keep the face, hair, hood and hair silhouette, costume, bell and chain, camera, three-quarter angle, crop, lighting, linework, painterly finish and flat green background of reference image 1 identical; the head may tilt by at most 5 degrees; change only the brows, eyes and mouth as described under EXPRESSION. Where a detail of reference image 1 disagrees with SUBJECT below, SUBJECT wins. SUBJECT: Fadyme, an adult woman aged 22 with a refined, mature face and adult proportions. Pale ash-blonde hair, a cool light beige-blonde with ash-grey shading, in long soft waves falling to the chest, drawn as thick strand groups with only a few fine flyaway strands. Violet eyes, a pale lavender-grey violet. A deep plum hood is raised over her head: plum fabric (#45293B in the light, #22151E in shadow) with silver-lilac (#C9B6E4) vine embroidery running along the hood edge and the cloak borders. On the front edge of the hood above the brow sits one small broken fragment of a silver circlet, a short arc with a few small points and one snapped end. One tiny silver bell-shaped hairpin sits at the side of her face, partly hidden by the hood edge and her hair. Under the mantle she wears a black high-collar dress with silver-lilac embroidery, and a high, clean, white scarf (bone ivory, #E9E2D4) is folded up under her chin. One hand in a thin, matte, dark glove is raised to the chest and holds a fine silver chain; a small silver bell hangs from it, with a long slender silver thorn as its clapper hanging motionless below the bell's mouth. The other hand is hidden in the mantle. EXPRESSION (soft smile): a warm closed-mouth smile, the lips closed and gently curved upward at both corners, the cheeks lifted slightly; eyes softened with relaxed lids and a slight narrowing at the lower lids, the gaze warm and straight at the viewer; brows soft and relaxed; the head tilted about 2 degrees toward the right of the frame. COMPOSITION: three-quarter view at eye level, the head turned slightly toward the right of the frame, eyes looking at the viewer. Chest-up, cropped at mid-torso so the mantle folds run off the bottom edge. Eyes about 27% down from the top; the hood apex about 4% below the top edge; the hood and mantle stay at least 6% inside the left and right edges; the face and the raised gloved hand sit inside the upper 60% of the height, the bell hangs just below the hand with its body ending near 66% of the height; the lowest 30% is plain dark mantle folds with nothing of interest. STYLE: painterly dark gothic anime light-novel illustration with a detailed face, finely drawn eyes with layered violet irises, and thin soft plum-black linework (never pure black), slightly heavier on the outer silhouette. Soft cel shading on the skin in two or three value steps; painterly gradients and fold occlusion on the cloth; matte woven wool and cloth; dull worn silver metal; fine visible brush grain and paper tooth. Quiet, hushed, melancholic, understated. LIGHT AND PALETTE: cool slate ambient light (#3B434D family) that traces the whole outline of the hood and mantle with a thin, soft silver-lilac (#C9B6E4) edge light so the dark plum separates from a dark backdrop, plus one soft warm amber rim light (#D9A441 family) on the viewer-right edge of the hood, hair and shoulder only; charcoal, deep plum, silver-lilac and bone ivory; low saturation except the plum, the lilac and the single amber rim; darkest value no darker than #0F0D11 and brightest highlight no brighter than #F2EDE4. TECHNICAL: the whole canvas behind the character is one flat pure #00FF00 chroma-key green, identical in all four corners, with no gradient, vignette, floor, cast shadow, glow, mist or particles; crisp hard silhouette edges without feathering or motion blur; no green on the character: no green rim light, reflection, tint or glow on hair, skin, metal or cloth. Text-free image. Do not include: text, letters, logos or watermarks; extra, missing or fused fingers; a white streak in the hair, blood on the scarf or glowing lines on the skin; red, burgundy, crimson or gold clothing; weapons, modern items, glasses, frames, borders or other people; teeth, an open mouth or blush marks.
